answer: Give every agent a stake that must sit in escrow before it can trade, and let a proven fake identity forfeit that stake to whoever exposed it. One willow bends in a gale, but a thousand fake willows would each need their own bond, so a sybil flood costs a fortune instead of nothing. Reputation then grows slowly from real deals, and the ripple of one exposed fraud warns the whole market before the next fake can cash in.
